purpose: Shared assumed-familiar vocabulary for Moonlight, Super Supportive and Name of the Wind episode authoring: original common words plus explicitly authorized, lexically reviewed recurring vocabulary. Latest expansion audits active Super Supportive 1–10 and Moonlight 1–28. Exposure is not reviewed mastery and does not change flashcards.
method: One active release per episode; sum maximum occurrences on one reachable route per episode. Count all visible choice options, but never add mutually exclusive branch responses together. Whole lexical units and useful fixed expressions are reviewed; productive grammatical combinations, word fragments, numeric false matches and proper names are excluded. Each dated expansion records its corpus and threshold; the 2026-11-03 expansion requires at least three occurrences across at least two episodes. No assumption about which route the learner played.

expansions.method: For each active catalog release, enumerate every reachable route, include all visible choice options, and take the maximum count per word on a single route. Sum these per-episode maxima. Do not sum exclusive branches or superseded versions. Counts are potential exposure, not a claim about played routes. Lexically review whole words/fixed expressions and exclude proper names, fragments and ambiguous pooled senses.
